related_questions.question: How do I see how much taxes are on a property?
related_questions.snippet: The local government sets the county tax rate (also known as the mill rate). The mill rate is multiplied by your property's assessed value to calculate your property taxes.

related_questions.question: What day are property taxes due in Michigan?
related_questions.snippet: When are my taxes due? The summer taxes are billed July 1st each year and are due by August 14th without penalties. The winter taxes are billed December 1st each year are due by February 14th without penalties. On March 1st, the delinquent tax rolls are given to the County Treasurer and additional penalties are added.
